title: LVD Lab Transcardial Perfusion Protocol
author: Laura Volpicelli-Daley
materials: 2. Make sure a thermometer is placed in dry ice/2-methylbutane mixture. Ensure the temperature stays between -20 to -30°C for snap-freezing brain tissue.

4. Use forceps to carefully place the brain into the 2-methylbutane (kept between -20 to -30°C with dry ice), which should be in a plastic beaker. Temperature of the 2-methylbutane should be monitored the entire time with a thermometer.

steps.title: Prepare 1X PBS with Sodium Nitroprusside and Heparin
steps.instruction: Prepare 1 L of 1X PBS containing 0.005% (v/v) Sodium nitroprusside and 10 U/mL Heparin sodium.

substeps.instruction: Combine 990 mL 1X PBS, 0.05 g Sodium nitroprusside (Catalog #A15656), and 10 mL Heparin sodium (Catalog #25021-400-30).
Dissolve 30 g of 30% Sucrose per 100 mL 1X PBS (final volume). For example, dissolve 150 g sucrose in 1X PBS and fill to a total of 500 mL.

steps.title: Prepare 4% Paraformaldehyde (PFA) Fixative
steps.instruction: Prepare 4% (v/v) PFA in PBS in a fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Add ~80% (~800 mL for a 1L batch) of ddH2O to a beaker with a stir bar and heat on a hot plate to approximately 55-60 °C; turn off the hot plate once this temperature is reached.
Measure 40 g of PFA (Catalog #AAA113130E) per 1 L final volume and add to the hot water, stirring vigorously until the majority is in solution.
While PFA dissolves, prepare an ice bath for subsequent cooling.
Add concentrated NaOH (Catalog #SS267) dropwise until the solution is no longer cloudy.
Move the beaker to the ice bath and monitor until the temperature reaches 20-25 °C.
Add 10X PBS to a final concentration of 1X (e.g., 100 mL of 10X PBS for a 1 L final volume).
Add ddH2O to reach the final volume mark (e.g., 1000 mL).
Adjust the pH to 7.4 using NaOH (Catalog #SS267) or HCl.
Filter the solution through a 0.2 μm or 0.45 μm filter flask.

steps.title: Store Fixative Solution
steps.instruction: Store the prepared PFA solution according to the required timeframe.

substeps.instruction: Store at 4 °C for up to one week, or aliquot into 50 mL tubes and store at -20 °C for up to 6 months.

steps.title: Anesthetize Mouse
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the mouse via isoflurane inhalation per approved IACUC protocol until the mouse no longer responds to tail or toe pinch.

steps.title: Perform Transcardial Perfusion
steps.instruction: Perfuse the mouse with cold 1X PBS and, if required, 4% PFA.

substeps.instruction: Place the needle through the apex of the heart, keeping it as straight and to the mouse's left as possible to remain in the left ventricle.
Cut the right atrium with scissors, turn on the pump, and manually hold the needle in place.
Perfuse with 25 mL total of cold 1X PBS containing Heparin sodium (Catalog #25021-400-30) at 3 ml/min (Pump Setting '8') until the liver clears of blood and turns lighter in color.
If 4% PFA perfusion is needed, perfuse with 25 mL total of cold 4% PFA in 1X PBS at 9 ml/min (Pump Setting '8').
If perfusing multiple mice, clear the tubing of excess PFA by running 1X PBS through the tubing into a waste container before the next mouse.

steps.title: Post-Fix Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Dissect desired tissue samples and post-fix them.

substeps.instruction: Place samples in 4% PFA in 1X PBS.
Immediately place glass vials on ice before storing at 4 °C for 24 hours.

steps.title: Process Brain Tissue for Histology
steps.instruction: Process post-fixed brain tissue for cryostat or microtome sectioning.

substeps.instruction: Rinse the brain tissue with 1X PBS (without sodium nitroprusside/heparin).
Place tissue in 30% Sucrose in PBS solution until the brain sinks to the bottom of the vial (estimated 24 to 48 hours).
Snap-freeze the tissue in 2-methylbutane and dry ice for 30 to 60 seconds until bubbling stops.
Wrap frozen brains individually in labeled aluminum foil (using solvent/temperature resistant labels) and store in a cardboard box at -80 °C.
